environment.docker_build_status: docker compose build backend FAILS with BuildKit 'DeadlineExceeded' (broad Phase-2/3 release recompile too heavy for 4.1GB VM)
environment.verification_method: native `cargo run` on the host (more RAM, faster) — the same code, bypassing the failing Docker build

phase_1_oom_fix.problem: Indexing a real repo OOM-killed the whole backend.

evidence_of_crash.logs: cut off cleanly after 'NexusMind listening' with no panic (classic OOM)

bisection.graph_only_true_no_embeddings: SUCCESS — 202 files, memory stable ~1.03 GB, no OOM
bisection.conclusion: OOM is 100% in the embedding pass (Pass 2), not parsing

phase_1_oom_fix.root_cause: Embedding sequence length was uncapped (nomic accepts up to 8192 tokens). Transformer activation memory scales with batch x seq_len x hidden x layers. The batch-count cap alone did NOT bound it.
fix: indexer/mod.rs: byte-bounded Pass-1 batching (8 MiB / 64 files)
main.rs + queries.rs: fail_stale_indexing_projects() marks interrupted 'indexing' projects as 'error' on startup

validation_after_fix.memory_during_embedding: PLATEAU at ~1.28 GB for 12+ minutes, never OOM, CPU pegged ~1152% (working)
validation_after_fix.zombie_cleanup_confirmed: restart flipped a stuck project to index_status='error' with 'Indexing interrupted (server restart)'

changes: walker.rs: exclude lockfiles (pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock, composer.lock, Gemfile.lock, go.sum, bun.lockb) and *.min.js/*.min.css
tree_sitter_chunker.rs: unsupported-language / empty-AST files fall back to line-window chunks so real code files always produce chunks
phase_2_coverage_and_noise.verdict: WORKS — 5x more embedded chunks; lockfiles excluded

changes: chunker.rs build_embed_text(): embed a skeleton (symbol name + signature + leading doc-comment) instead of the raw body; body still stored for get_context
POST /v1/code/locate: returns ranked DISTINCT file paths only { file_path, top_symbol, score } (token-cheap for agents)
phase_3_skeleton_and_locate.verdict: WORKS — /locate returns paths-only; skeleton embedding active

changes: tree_sitter_chunker.rs: fold the preceding doc-comment into each symbol chunk so build_embed_text captures it (TS/Rust/etc.)
indexer/mod.rs + queries.count_chunks_for_project(): fresh index reports the ACTUAL chunk_count (was 0)
api/code.rs + queries.ensure_code_project_visible_to_creator(): on index, create the matching projects row + enroll the creator as member so a non-super_user creator can see/search their project

validation_native_as_PLAIN_admin_not_sup.creator_visibility: project 'ecom' NOW appears in GET /v1/code/projects and is searchable (BEFORE this fix it returned [] and /search gave 404)
validation_native_as_PLAIN_admin_not_sup.index_result: status=success, files=145 (docs/config now excluded from 194), chunk_count=159 (was 0 — counter bug fixed)

phase_4_precision_iteration.verdict: WORKS — both read bugs fixed; docs/config removed from corpus

bugs_found_during_verification.desc: code_projects.chunk_count stayed 0 after a fresh index (Pass 2 inserts never incremented the counter). Real chunks existed.

An indexed code project was invisible to its non-super_user creator: /v1/code/projects returned [] and /v1/code/search returned 404, because list_code_projects_visible requires a projects row + project_visibility membership that post_index never created.

search_precision_before_after.note: BEFORE = Docker baseline (raw bodies embedded, docs+lockfiles indexed). AFTER = native, Phase-4 code (skeleton embeddings, code-only corpus). Scores are cosine similarity.

queries.assessment: IMPROVED — a real service file is now #1 (was an interface)
PARTIAL — lockfile noise gone, but still returns event classes not an order controller (repo has thin controllers; event-driven)
IMPROVED — docs gone; a service file surfaces (some UI noise remains)
PARTIAL — config/lockfile gone; a step file surfaces, but events still rank
IMPROVED — real kafka code now #1 and #2 (was docs)

search_precision_before_after.overall: Materially better: docs/lockfiles/config eliminated from every result; real service/handler files now surface at top-1/top-2 for most queries. NOT yet 'super exact' for a couple of queries (event-driven repo surfaces event classes over thin controllers). Further gains require heavier technique: symbol-kind weighting (deprioritize interfaces/events) + keyword+semantic hybrid + a re-ranking pass.
